preconditions.description: Each string in the input list is composed of exactly two words (first name and last name).

postconditions.expression: all(reindeer[i].split()[1] <= reindeer[j].split()[1] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output list is sorted in non-decreasing order by the last names of the reindeer (second word of each string).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == reindeer[i] or reindeer[i].split()[1] != reindeer[j].split()[1] for i in range(len(reindeer)) for j in range(len(reindeer)) if reindeer[i].split()[1] == reindeer[j].split()[1] and return_value.index(reindeer[i]) < return_value.index(reindeer[j]))
postconditions.description: For reindeer with identical last names, their original relative order in the input list is preserved (stable sort).
The output list contains exactly the same reindeer names as the input list, with no duplicates or omissions.
